current_answer: As checked on October 21, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found. Coverage of a September interview reports Rockstar technology director Phil Hooker saying the game continued to evolve and some things changed in recent months; the coverage does not identify what changed or establish an unfinished build or schedule risk. No official native PC version, date, or window has been announced; GamesBeat’s Q1 2027 report remains based on four anonymous sources. Cyberleek’s conditional full-build release threat was reportedly withdrawn after its token target was missed, but the threat and a separate spoiler claim remain unverified. These findings do not change confidence in the official console commitment.

catalogue_card.question: Does the “still changing” report mean GTA VI is unfinished or delayed?
catalogue_card.text: The reported interview statement says development continued to evolve and some things changed in recent months. It does not identify the changes or establish an unfinished build or delay. Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found.

GamesRadar and Vice report that Bloomberg’s October 14 feature quoted Rockstar technology director Phil Hooker on continued development changes. The statement does not identify the changes or establish build status or schedule risk; Bloomberg could not be accessed directly in this check.
No official native PC version, date, or window has been announced. GamesBeat reports a Q1 2027 PC plan from four anonymous sources; follow-up reports are not independent confirmation.
Reporting says Cyberleek withdrew its conditional full-build release threat after its token target was missed. Neither that threat nor a separate spoiler claim is independently verified.
Take-Two scheduled fiscal Q2 2027 results for November 9, 2026, a future official checkpoint, not release evidence.
Analytics were unavailable; reader behavior and product value remain unknown.
uncertainty: November 19 remains an official console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two earlier target movements remain relevant.
